annotations.title: Scope of work old against new

description: AICTIONBOT™ scope of work comparison by KULIC Advisory (tool 69). Takes the full text of the old and the new version of a scope of work, service description or statement of work. Splits both into sections, matches them by wording, number and similarity and returns: dropped sections (red), changed sections with the sentences before and now, the figures, quantities, deadlines and dates that differ, new restrictions such as not included, at extra cost, on request or best effort, and new duties for the customer (all red), other changes and new sections (yellow), ready questions for the other side and the next step. It shows what changed in the wording, not what it means legally. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Not legal advice. To compare two contract versions use compare_contracts, to write a scope of work use write_scope_of_work. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).
